paragraphs.body: Bradley Beal is ruled out to play against the Sacramento Kings due to a knee injury, according to NBC Sports. He remains unavailable for the upcoming game against the Lakers as well, with NBC Sports confirming his continued absence. Additionally, the Los Angeles Clippers have indicated that Chris Paul's old jersey number will be retired in Beal's honor, as reported by ABC30 Fresno.

headline: Bradley Beal ruled out for two games as Clippers honor legacy with jersey retirement
